text:
Iris (CSM): Citrine just finished a staging ramp and saw a burst of 429s during SDK init. Theyare worried about renewal next week. They report failures mostly in the first 8s after a deploy. Ticket: CS-56012

Ben (Support Eng): Can you paste the tiny log they sent? 429s on init usually = preflight token exhaust or parallel init.

Iris (CSM): Log snippet:```
2026-05-20T14:01:02Z WARN rate_limiter preflight deny tenant=citrine count=132 window=1s
2026-05-20T14:01:02Z ERROR http 429 preflight_exhausted
```

Kai (DevEx): 132/s implies many clients fetching ephemeral tokens at once. Do they call SDK.init() from multiple widgets/frames?

Iris (CSM): Yes 0 micro-frontends and an analytics iframe all call init on mount; they kept SDK default autoFetch=true.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Immediate guidance: 1) Turn off auto token prefetch and fetch one token server-side per session. 2) For embedded frames, use postMessage to share the token from the parent. 3) Add a randomized splay (300000ms) before init in client code. 4) Implement exponential backoff for 429s so UX degrades gracefully.

Ben (Support Eng): Sent them a tiny retry snippet and splay example. Also asked for user-agent and exact SDK version.

Iris (CSM): Citrine asked if we can provide temporary relief while they roll the fix this afternoon. Renewal is sensitive so they requested ASAP.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Ops can approve a short-lived preflight bump. Proposal: increase per-tenant preflight from 120/s -> 480/s for 3 hours while they validate. I will own the change and monitoring.

infra-bot: Change request CR-9001 opened for tenant=citrine: preflight quota bump 120->480/s, window 2026-05-20T15:00:00Z to 2026-05-20T18:00:00Z. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Kai (DevEx): I'll add a one-paragraph note to onboarding docs: "If you use multiple widgets or iframes, prefer single token per session + splay; avoid SDK auto-fetch in embedded contexts." Filed DX-1407 to add an SDK init splay option and examples.

Iris (CSM): I'll update the customer: client changes + short-lived quota bump as stopgap. Ask them to validate by 17:30 UTC and post results here so we can close CR-9001.

Ben (Support Eng): Thanks 29; ping me when validation is done so we can revert the bump if not needed.

Iris (CSM): Will do.
